literal_source_claim: Every consistent formal system containing arithmetic is incomplete.
domain_and_universes: Open: the source must fix the formal theory, its effective presentation, syntax and proof calculus, arithmetic interpretation, consistency notion, and external metatheory.
conclusion: Open: incompleteness may mean existence of a sentence with neither it nor its negation provable, but the repository record does not fix the sentence class or provability relation.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Not yet frozen. Inconsistent, non-effective, non-classical, finitely weak, and semantically rather than syntactically presented systems require explicit source treatment; mere extension by symbols is not the required interpretation of arithmetic.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; object-theory and metatheoretic classical/constructive principles are not yet frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact imports and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No oracle, experiment, unchecked reflection, or certificate is credited; effective syntax/proof coding will require a frozen computability policy
formal_system: Lean 4 + mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source edition or variant selection, canonical wording, consistency or arithmetic-strength choice, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, assurance profile, or validator change; review due date and independent reviewers remain open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. A pinned Lean probe checks the available Godel beta-function ingredient, not incompleteness. No exact source variant, canonical Lean target, H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
